dataset.raw_data: GSE324210_MONOCYTE_RNA_SEQ_healthy.xlsx (60,660 genes x 83 samples, GEO supplementary)

description: FME cuadro: GSE324210 (adolescent monocyte exercise-response, n=21 subjects, 83 samples, 8-week endurance + acute bout, 35 female samples / 9 female subjects) baseline for exercise-response module vs FM cohorts (GSE221921/GSE67311 blank series). GSE334369 (blunted-response FM) completes the 2x2.

female_stratification.note: FM ~90% female. Female-only T1->T2: TAC1 +0.60 log2FC (vs +0.31 all), CA14 +0.61 (vs +0.16 all), TLR4 -0.31 (vs -0.01 all). Sex-stratified analysis mandatory.

hash_method: eidos-canonicalization-v1 (excludes spec_hash and hash_method, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

key_findings_T1_vs_T2.interpretation: Monocyte acute-exercise response in healthy adolescents: immune activation (IL1B UP) + sensory neuropeptide shift (TAC1 UP, MRGPRX2 DOWN), sex-specific in females. Opioid receptors (OPRM1/OPRK1/OPRD1) and DRD2 essentially silent in monocytes at transcript level.

kill_criterion.result: PASS marginal: IL1B +0.54, TAC1 +0.31, MRGPRX2 -0.33 = 3 genes at threshold; CA14 female-only +0.61 strengthens sex-stratified signal

next_steps: Cross-map exercise-response module vs FM blank series GSE221921/GSE67311
Test TAC1/MRGPRX2 axis blunting in FM monocytes
